title: From Prediction to Decision: Decision-Focused Fine-Tuning of Autoregressive Tabular Transformers for Cost-Sensitive Financial Events
abstract: arXiv:2611.34858v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive transformers trained on tokenized tabular event streams are a simple and strong baseline for predicting financial events such as fraud. Yet institutions do not act on probabilities; they act on decisions whose consequences are asymmetric and heteroscedastic: the cost of a missed high-value fraud and that of a wrongly declined small purchase are not the same. The standard bridge is post-hoc Bayes-optimal thresholding of calibrated probabilities under a cost matrix. We ask whether fine-tuning the model to the decision objective can do better. We fine-tune the same pretrained model so that its restricted softmax over label tokens (already a distribution over business actions) maximizes expected utility under an institution-specified, amount-scaled cost matrix. translated_title: 从预测到决策：面向成本敏感金融事件的自回归表格Transformer决策导向微调
translated_abstract: 在标记化表格事件流上训练的自回归Transformer是预测金融事件（如欺诈）的一个简单而强大的基线模型。然而，机构并非依据概率行事，而是依据决策行事，而这些决策的后果是非对称且异方差的：漏检一笔高价值欺诈的代价与错误拒绝一笔小额交易的代价并不相同。连接二者的标准方法是事后在成本矩阵下对校准概率进行贝叶斯最优阈值划分。我们探究将模型微调至决策目标是否能取得更好的效果。我们对同一预训练模型进行微调，使其在标签token上的受限softmax（其本身已是业务动作的分布）在机构指定的、按金额缩放的成本矩阵下最大化期望效用。由于奖励是（动作、结果、金额）的已知函数，且结果在数据中可直接观测，期望效用目标函数及其梯度均可解析获得。
tldr: 本文提出决策导向微调方法，通过直接最大化预训练自回归表格Transformer在按金额缩放成本矩阵下的期望效用，使模型输出从概率预测转变为面向业务动作的决策优化，从而在成本敏感的金融欺诈检测中优于传统的事后阈值划分方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes decision-focused fine-tuning that directly maximizes the expected utility of pretrained autoregressive tabular transformers under an amount-scaled cost matrix, shifting model outputs from probability prediction to decision optimization and outperforming post-hoc thresholding for cost-sensitive financial fraud detection.
